text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, the "Summer Training Camp" finally 
begins— A massive joint intensive training 
camp is underway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fully motivated for the Shuka Sho. We want 
to aim for an even greater boost in 
ability here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this summer... is going to be a 
hot one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~. I heard the temperatures are 
higher than usual this year~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's part of it, but... that's 
not what I meant just now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, Bright, you're hopeless. 
...Let's both make this a great summer 
camp, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Swimming at the beach, seaside food 
stalls, right~? Pillow fights, fireworks, 
festivals—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! Didn't you understand what 
the training was for?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
――As for me, aiming towards the Kikuka 
Sho~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'm heading towards the Shuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp, let's do this! Summer camp, 
fight on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our passionate summer training 
camp with Mejiro Dober had begun!
